description.en: Small prophetic practices for everyday life
Simple prophetic habits for daily living

items.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا أَوَىٰ إِلَىٰ فِرَاشِهِ نَامَ عَلَىٰ شِقِّهِ الْأَيْمَنِ
items.transliteration: Kanan-Nabiyyu sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam idha awa ila firashihi nama 'ala shiqqihil-ayman.

translation.en: The Prophet ﷺ, when he went to bed, would sleep on his right side.

virtues.en: A simple physical sunnah observed nightly before sleep.

title.en: Entering the Masjid with the Right Foot

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-ftah li abwaba rahmatik.

translation.en: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

virtues.en: Said while stepping into the masjid with the right foot first.

title.en: Leaving the Masjid with the Left Foot

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You from Your favor.

virtues.en: Said while stepping out of the masjid with the left foot first.

items.arabic: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلِ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah — then the other replies: Yarhamukallah — then the sneezer responds: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.

translation.en: When one of you sneezes, let him say 'Praise be to Allah'; his companion should reply 'May Allah have mercy on you'; and he should then reply 'May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.'

virtues.en: A small daily exchange of mercy and gratitude between believers.

items.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
items.transliteration: As-salamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.

translation.en: Peace, the mercy of Allah, and His blessings be upon you.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said none of you truly believes until you love for your brother what you love for yourself, and spreading salam is a means of that love.

items.arabic: الْإِيمَانُ بِضْعٌ وَسَبْعُونَ أَوْ بِضْعٌ وَسِتُّونَ شُعْبَةً... وَأَدْنَاهَا إِمَاطَةُ الْأَذَىٰ عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ
items.transliteration: Al-imanu bidh'un wa sab'una aw bidh'un wa sittuna shu'bah... wa adnaha imatatul-adha 'anit-tariq.

translation.en: Faith has over seventy branches, the least of which is removing harm from the road.

virtues.en: A reminder that even small acts of public good are a part of faith.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur

translation.en: All praise is due to Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "When one of you wakes up, let him say: Alhamdu lillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur." This expresses gratitude for the gift of life and reminds the believer of the Day of Resurrection. Sleep is a form of minor death, and waking is a reminder that Allah will resurrect us. (Bukhari 6312, Muslim 2711)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba-ith

translation.en: O Allah, I seek Your protection from the male and female devils.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "When any one of you enters the toilet, let him say: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the male and female devils (khubuth and khaba-ith)." This dua should be said with the left foot entering first. (Bukhari 142, Muslim 375, Abu Dawud 6)

items.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
items.transliteration: Ghufaranak

translation.en: I seek Your forgiveness (Your pardon).

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم would say "Ghufaranak" upon exiting the bathroom. Even though using the bathroom is a natural act, the believer seeks Allah's forgiveness as a sign of humility and to maintain a state of purity with Allah. Exit with the right foot first. (Tirmidhi 7, Abu Dawud 30)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "There is no wudu for the one who does not mention the Name of Allah upon it." Starting with Bismillah is a sunnah mu'akkadah (strongly recommended) and brings barakah to the act of purification. (Tirmidhi 24, Ibn Majah 397)

items.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.transliteration: Ashhadu alla ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh

translation.en: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "Whoever performs wudu and does it well, then says: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah... the eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him, and he may enter through whichever one he wishes." (Muslim 234)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَةِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi wa barakatillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah and with the blessings of Allah.

reference.collection: Sahih al-Bukhari 5376, Sahih Muslim 2022, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 1856

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "When one of you eats, let him mention the name of Allah. If he forgets to mention the name of Allah at the beginning, let him say: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu (In the name of Allah at its beginning and end)." The Prophet also added "wa barakatillah" when eating. (Bukhari 5376, Muslim 2022, Tirmidhi 1856)

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana muslimeen

translation.en: All praise is due to Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "Allah is pleased with His servant when he eats food and praises Him for it, and when he drinks and praises Him for it." A shorter version "Alhamdulillah" is also from the Sunnah. (Muslim 2734, Abu Dawud 3854)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا أَنْتَ، رَبِّي كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ وَعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu kama anta, rabbi kama yanbaghi li-jalali wajhika wa azeemi sultanik

translation.en: O Allah, to You is all praise as You are, my Lord, as is befitting for the majesty of Your Face and the greatness of Your authority.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said this when wearing a new garment, then he would call it by its name — whether shirt (qamis), turban (imamah), or cloak (rida). A beautiful expression of gratitude acknowledging Allah's greatness. (Tirmidhi 1769, Abu Dawud 4020)

title.en: Dua When Looking in the Mirror

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ كَمَا أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma kama ahsanta khalqi fahassin khuluqi

translation.en: O Allah, just as You have made my outward appearance good, make my character good.

virtues.en: This dua is narrated from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم. It teaches that beauty of the soul (character) is far more important than beauty of the body. When one looks at their reflection, they should remember to ask Allah to beautify their inner self. (Reported by Ahmad, graded Hasan by Al-Albani in Sahih al-Jami 4862)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu alallahi wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

translation.en: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "When a man leaves his house and says: Bismillahi tawakkaltu alallahi wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah — it is said to him: You are guided, sufficed, and protected." Then Shaytan keeps away from him. (Tirmidhi 3426, Abu Dawud 5095)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَجَأْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillahi wajana wa bismillahi khrajna wa alallahi rabbina tawakkalna

translation.en: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah, our Lord, we rely.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم taught that one should greet (salam) when entering the home and begin with Bismillah. By doing so, Shaytan is instructed: "You have no place to stay tonight." (Bukhari 5377, Abu Dawud 5096)

title.en: Dua When Going to the Mosque

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي عِظَامِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ وَرَائِي نُورًا وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا
items.transliteration: Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nuran, wa fi basari nuran, wa fi sam'i nuran, wa fi izami nuran, waj'al min wara-i nuran, wa min amami nuran, wa min fawqi nuran, wa min tahti nuran

translation.en: O Allah, place light in my heart, and light in my sight, and light in my hearing, and light in my bones. Make light before me and light behind me, and light above me and light below me.

virtues.en: Part of a longer dua the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم would recite when going to the mosque. The full version includes asking for light in every limb and in all directions. Every step to the mosque raises one's rank. (Bukhari 6316, Muslim 763)

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلَاثًا)
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullah (thalathan)

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah (three times).

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم would immediately say Astaghfirullah three times after the taslim. This shows that even after the most perfect act of worship (prayer), the believer turns to Allah in humility seeking forgiveness for any shortcomings. (Muslim 591)

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah

translation.en: All praise is due to Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: "When one of you sneezes, let him say: Alhamdulillah." And the one who hears should say: "Yarhamukallah" (May Allah have mercy on you)." Sneezing is a blessing from Allah as it expels irritants from the body. (Bukhari 6223, Muslim 2991)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanalladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala-ikatu min kheefatihi

translation.en: Exalted is He Whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels out of fear of Him.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم used to say this when he heard thunder. It is derived from the Quran (13:13) and reminds us that even thunder and angels glorify Allah. A moment of awe and remembrance. (Malik 494, Tirmidhi 3450)

description.en: Everyday Sunnah acts and prophetic etiquette across daily situations.
description.ar: أعمال السنة اليومية والآداب النبوية في مختلف المواقف.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah.
translation.ar: بسم الله

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "There is no wudu for the one who does not mention the name of Allah upon it."
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "There is no wudu for the one who does not mention the name of Allah upon it."

items.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.transliteration: Ash-hadu alla ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh

translation.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
translation.ar: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله

virtues.en: The eight gates of Paradise will be opened for the one who recites this after wudu, and he may enter through whichever one he wishes.
virtues.ar: The eight gates of Paradise will be opened for the one who recites this after wudu, and he may enter through whichever one he wishes.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik

translation.en: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
translation.ar: اللهم افتح لي أبواب رحمتك

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك من فضلك

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah

translation.en: All praise is for Allah.
translation.ar: الحمد لله

virtues.en: When a Muslim sneezes and praises Allah, it is a duty upon every Muslim who hears him to say: "Yarhamukallah" (May Allah have mercy on you).
virtues.ar: When a Muslim sneezes and praises Allah, it is a duty upon every Muslim who hears him to say: "Yarhamukallah" (May Allah have mercy on you).

items.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Yarhamukallah

translation.en: May Allah have mercy on you.
translation.ar: يرحمك الله

items.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
items.transliteration: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum

translation.en: May Allah guide you and set right your affairs.
translation.ar: يهديكم الله ويصلح بالكم

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi kasani hadha ath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or might from me.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي كساني هذا الثوب ورزقنيه من غير حول مني ولا قوة

virtues.en: Whoever wears a garment and says this, Allah will forgive all his past sins.
virtues.ar: Whoever wears a garment and says this, Allah will forgive all his past sins.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma kama ahsanta khalqi fa ahsin khuluqi

translation.en: O Allah, just as You have made my external form beautiful, make my character beautiful.
translation.ar: اللهم كما أحسنت خلقي فحسن خلقي

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna wa bismillahi khrajna wa alallahi rabbana tawakkalna

translation.en: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
translation.ar: بسم الله ولجنا وبسم الله خرجنا وعلى الله ربنا توكلنا

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu alallahi, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

translation.en: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
translation.ar: بسم الله توكلت على الله لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "When a man leaves his house and says this, it is said to him: You are guided, sufficed, and protected. The devils distance themselves from him.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "When a man leaves his house and says this, it is said to him: You are guided, sufficed, and protected. The devils distance themselves from him.

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanalladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min khifatih

translation.en: Glory be to the One whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels from fear of Him.
translation.ar: سبحان الذي يسبح الرعد بحمده والملائكة من خيفته

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَقْتُلْنَا بِغَضَبِكَ وَلَا تُهْلِكْنَا بِعَذَابِكَ وَعَافِنَا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma la taqtulna bi-ghadabik wa la tuhlikna bi-'adhabik wa aafina qabla dhalik

translation.en: O Allah, do not kill us with Your wrath and do not destroy us with Your punishment, and grant us well-being before that.
translation.ar: اللهم لا تقتلنا بغضبك ولا تهلكنا بعذابك وعافنا قبل ذلك

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma ahillahu alayna bil-amni wal-iman was-salamati wal-islam, wat-tawfiqi lima tuhibbu wa tardha, rabbuna wa rabbukallah

translation.en: O Allah, make it a moon of security, faith, safety, and Islam. Grant us success in what You love and are pleased with. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
translation.ar: اللهم أهله علينا بالأمن والإيمان والسلامة والإسلام والتوفيق لما تحب وترضى ربنا وربك الله

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, Allahu akbar, walillahil-hamd

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, there is no god but Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and all praise is for Allah.
translation.ar: الله أكبر الله أكبر لا إله إلا الله والله أكبر الله أكبر ولله الحمد

items.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
items.transliteration: As-salamu alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh

translation.en: May the peace, mercy, and blessings of Allah be upon you.
translation.ar: السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not tell you about something which, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread the greeting of peace among yourselves."
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not tell you about something which, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread the greeting of peace among yourselves."

items.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
items.transliteration: Wa alaykumus-salam wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh

translation.en: And upon you be peace, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
translation.ar: وعليكم السلام ورحمة الله وبركاته

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi rabbil-'alameen

translation.en: All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
translation.ar: الحمد لله رب العالمين

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "If two Muslims meet and shake hands, their sins are forgiven before they separate.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "If two Muslims meet and shake hands, their sins are forgiven before they separate.

items.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
items.transliteration: Jazakallahu khayran

translation.en: May Allah reward you with goodness.
translation.ar: جزاك الله خيرا

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem

translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
translation.ar: أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "I know a word which, if he were to say it, what he feels would go away: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "I know a word which, if he were to say it, what he feels would go away: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.

items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-azeem

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Noble Throne.
translation.ar: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو عليه توكلت وهو رب العرش العظيم

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever says this seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him for everything that concerns him.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever says this seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him for everything that concerns him.

items.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
items.transliteration: Barakallahu laka fi ahlika wa malik

translation.en: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth.
translation.ar: بارك الله لك في أهلك ومالك

items.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Yarhamukallah

translation.en: May Allah have mercy on you.
translation.ar: يرحمك الله

virtues.en: If someone sneezes three or more times, it is said: "May Allah heal you" (Yashfikallah) instead of "May Allah have mercy on you."
virtues.ar: If someone sneezes three or more times, it is said: "May Allah heal you" (Yashfikallah) instead of "May Allah have mercy on you."

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah.
translation.ar: بسم الله

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) prohibited drinking while standing. He would drink in three sips, sitting down.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) prohibited drinking while standing. He would drink in three sips, sitting down.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (في البداية)
items.transliteration: Bismillah (at the beginning)

translation.en: In the name of Allah (at the beginning).
translation.ar: بسم الله

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would breathe three times when drinking, saying: "It is more satisfying, healthier, and more thirst-quenching.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would breathe three times when drinking, saying: "It is more satisfying, healthier, and more thirst-quenching.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana muslimeen

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي أطعمنا وسقانا وجعلنا مسلمين

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an

translation.en: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.
translation.ar: اللهم صيبا نافعا

items.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
items.transliteration: Umirna bifadlillahi wa rahmatih

translation.en: We have been given rain by the bounty of Allah and His mercy.
translation.ar: مطرنا بفضل الله ورحمته

items.arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Mashallah, la quwwata illa billah

translation.en: What Allah has willed — there is no power except with Allah.
translation.ar: ما شاء الله لا قوة إلا بالله

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "If one of you sees something in himself or in his wealth or in his brother that he admires, let him pray for blessing over it, for the evil eye is real.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "If one of you sees something in himself or in his wealth or in his brother that he admires, let him pray for blessing over it, for the evil eye is real.

items.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in shaa Allah

translation.en: No harm, it is a purification, if Allah wills.
translation.ar: لا بأس طهور إن شاء الله

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
items.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamhu wa 'fu anhu wa 'afihi wa akrim nuzulahu wa wassi' mudkhalahu wagh-silhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad

translation.en: O Allah, forgive him, have mercy upon him, pardon him, grant him well-being, honor his resting place, and make his entrance wide. Wash him with water, snow, and hail.
translation.ar: اللهم اغفر له وارحمه وعف عنه وعافه وأكرم نزله ووسع مدخله واغسله بالماء والثلج والبرد

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever attends the funeral and prays over it will get one qirat, and whoever attends until it is buried will get two qirats." A qirat is like Uhud mountain.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever attends the funeral and prays over it will get one qirat, and whoever attends until it is buried will get two qirats." A qirat is like Uhud mountain.

items.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَلَاحِقُونَ
items.transliteration: As-salamu alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu'mineena wal-muslimeen, wa inna in shaa Allahu bikum lala-hiqun

translation.en: Peace be upon you, O people of the dwellings, believers and Muslims. If Allah wills, we shall join you.
translation.ar: السلام عليكم أهل الديار من المؤمنين والمسلمين وإنا إن شاء الله بكم للاحقون

items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik, Allahummagh-fir li

translation.en: There is no god but You, glory be to You. O Allah, all praise is for You. O Allah, forgive me.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك اللهم اغفر لي

virtues.en: Whoever wakes up at night and says this, then makes dua, his dua will be answered. If he makes wudu and prays, his prayer will be accepted.
virtues.ar: Whoever wakes up at night and says this, then makes dua, his dua will be answered. If he makes wudu and prays, his prayer will be accepted.

items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismikallahumma amutu wa ahya

translation.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
translation.ar: باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur

translation.en: O Allah, by Your grace we enter the morning and by Your grace we enter the evening. By You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
translation.ar: اللهم بك أصبحنا وبك أمسينا وبك نحيا وبك نموت وإليك النشور

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا
items.transliteration: Bismillah, alhamdulillah, subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana haza

translation.en: In the name of Allah, all praise is for Allah. Glory be to the One Who has subjected this for us.
translation.ar: بسم الله الحمد لله سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا

items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayr

translation.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. He gives life and causes death. He is Ever-Living and never dies. In His hand is all good.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد يحيي ويموت وهو حي لا يموت بيده الخير

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever enters the marketplace and says this, Allah will record for him a million good deeds, erase a million evil deeds, and raise him by a million ranks.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever enters the marketplace and says this, Allah will record for him a million good deeds, erase a million evil deeds, and raise him by a million ranks.

items.arabic: أَحَبُّكَ فِي اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Uhibbuka fillah

translation.en: I love you for the sake of Allah.
translation.ar: أحبك في الله

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "A man will be with those whom he loves" in the Hereafter.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "A man will be with those whom he loves" in the Hereafter.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الزَّمْهَرِيرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْحَرِّ وَالْجَحِيمِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minaz-zamhariri wa a'udhu bika minal-harri wal-jaheem

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the severe cold and I seek refuge in You from the heat of Hellfire.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الزمهرير وأعوذ بك من الحر والجحيم

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadan al-waseelata wal-fadeelata wab'athhu maqaman mahmudan

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the means and the excellence, and raise him to the praised station.
translation.ar: اللهم رب هذه الدعوة التامة والصلاة القائمة آت محمدا الوسيلة والفضيلة وابعثه مقاما محمودا

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever says this after hearing the adhan, my intercession will be guaranteed for him on the Day of Judgment.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever says this after hearing the adhan, my intercession will be guaranteed for him on the Day of Judgment.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جَبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabba jibra'ila wa mika'ila wa israfeela fatiras-samawati wal-ardi 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of Jibreel, Mika'eel, and Israfeel, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen.
translation.ar: اللهم رب جبرائيل وميكائيل وإسرافيل فاطر السماوات والأرض عالم الغيب والشهادة

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever offers the Fajr prayer and then sits in his place of prayer remembering Allah until sunrise, then prays two rak'ahs, he will have a reward like that of Hajj and Umrah.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever offers the Fajr prayer and then sits in his place of prayer remembering Allah until sunrise, then prays two rak'ahs, he will have a reward like that of Hajj and Umrah.

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثلاثًا) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullah (3x) Allahumma antas-Salamu wa minkas-Salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram

translation.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah (3x). O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You comes all peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
translation.ar: أستغفر الله (ثلاثا) اللهم أنت السلام ومنك السلام تباركت يا ذا الجلال والإكرام

items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismikallahumma amutu wa ahya

translation.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
translation.ar: باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا

reference.notes: Also reported: Sahih al-Bukhari 6954. Also reported: Sahih al-Bukhari 6954.

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) used to sleep on his right side, placing his right hand under his right cheek.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) used to sleep on his right side, placing his right hand under his right cheek.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an wa rizqan wasi'an wa shifa'an min kulli da'

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision, and healing from every disease.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك علما نافعا ورزقا واسعا وشفاء من كل داء

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "The water of Zamzam is for whatever it is drunk for.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "The water of Zamzam is for whatever it is drunk for.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi aafani mima ibtalaka bihi wa faddalani ala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeelan

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who has kept me safe from that with which He has tested you, and has favored me above many of His creation.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي عافاني مما ابتلاك به وفضلني على كثير ممن خلق تفضيلا

items.arabic: وَقُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ
items.transliteration: Wa qul lil-mu'minati yaghuddhunna min absarihinna

translation.en: And tell the believing women to lower their gaze.
translation.ar: وقل للمؤمنات يغضضن من أبصارهن

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "A gaze is a poisoned arrow from the arrows of Satan. Whoever abandons it out of fear of Allah, He will grant him faith that he will find sweet in his heart.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "A gaze is a poisoned arrow from the arrows of Satan. Whoever abandons it out of fear of Allah, He will grant him faith that he will find sweet in his heart.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَةِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi wa barakatillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah and with the blessings of Allah.
translation.ar: بسم الله وبركة الله

items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.transliteration: Asbahna ala fitratil-islam wa ala kalimatil-ikhlas wa ala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad wa ala millati abina Ibrahim hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikeen

translation.en: We have entered the morning upon the natural disposition of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, and upon the religion of our father Ibrahim, upright and Muslim, and he was not of the polytheists.
translation.ar: أصبحنا على فطرة الإسلام وعلى كلمة الإخلاص وعلى دين نبينا محمد وعلى ملة أبيينا إبراهيم حنيفا مسلما وما كان من المشركين

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever says this in the morning, he has fulfilled the obligation of thanking Allah for that day. And whoever says it in the evening, he has fulfilled the obligation of thanking Allah for that night.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever says this in the morning, he has fulfilled the obligation of thanking Allah for that day. And whoever says it in the evening, he has fulfilled the obligation of thanking Allah for that night.
